The FAQ for GTC and the airdrop can be found here
http://support.gitcoin.co/kb/section/4
Please check the FAQ before posting your question!
If the dApp shows you have
0 GTC
to claim, it may be because, as of the Gitcoin token launch on May 25, 2021,
GTC was allocated to people who participated in Gitcoin grants, hackathons, bounties, or KERNEL prior to April 1, 2021.
Please review the eligibility requirements and follow the instructions to complete and submit the form if you feel you should be eligible:
How do I know if i'm eligible for the airdrop? - Gitcoin Support
For eligible participants, there is a 30 day period to claim your GTC.(editado)
